name: Viola Mintz
source:
Charlotte's private tutor.
She has a calm personality and often seems to be spacing out.
She can be dangerously air-headed at times.
Even though she's just Charlotte's teacher, they act like sisters, she really gives off a big sisterly impression.
She used to dream of being a musician in the past and is good at playing the piano.
